summary: Deploy the app on Internet Computer with a live canister URL and optional custom domain; user requested redeploy using a different canister ID and to retry deployment after an internal build error.
architectural_notes: Deployment target: Internet Computer canister (icp0.io URL).
Custom domain sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in planned but pending DNS verification.
known_issues: Build/deploy process encountered an internal LLM error during attempt to use another canister ID.

existing_features.title: Provision and deploy the app to a new Internet Computer canister ID (i.e., do not reuse the previously deployed canister), so the live site is served from the new canister.

If a custom domain is configured for the project, ensure the custom-domain verification file and deployment instructions remain consistent with the new canister deployment (i.e., do not break existing custom domain setup for `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in`).

new_feature_requests.summary: Redeploy using a different Internet Computer canister ID (new canister)
Retry the build/deploy after the internal LLM/build error
Update the frontend canister/agent configuration used by `createActorWithConfig` so the UI talks to the newly deployed backend canister ID after redeploying.
